claims.statement: Proves the rational Hodge conjecture for every complex CM abelian variety, in every dimension and codimension.
assumptions: The abelian variety has complex multiplication.
claims.conclusion: Every rational Hodge class on such a variety is a rational linear combination of algebraic cycle classes.

claims.statement: Through Milne's theorems, this also gives the Tate conjecture for all abelian varieties over finite fields.
assumptions: Milne's theorems connect the rational Hodge conjecture for CM abelian varieties to the Tate conjecture.
The abelian variety is defined over a finite field.
claims.conclusion: The Tate conjecture holds for all abelian varieties over finite fields.
